name: Hyperliquid
thesis: At ~$87 (11% off ATH) HYPE trades at ~29x market cap / ~108x FDV on ~$770M annualized holder revenue while its perp-DEX volume share has fallen from ~58% to 38% and monthly contributor tranches land on the 6th. In a bearish BTC/ETH regime the pro-cyclical buyback shrinks exactly as supply and a relative-strength unwind arrive.

confirmed_catalysts.description: Monthly core-contributor distribution; size disputed (Tokenomist $923.63M vs CoinLaunch 6.43M HYPE vs DefiLlama none scheduled)
Assistance Fund has removed 49.87M HYPE (4.99% of max supply) via buybacks
Castle Labs: Hyperliquid 38% of $15.0B/day on-chain perp volume, 56% of OI ($7.55B)

speculative_catalysts: Treasury-company accumulation (33.79M HYPE held per DefiLlama)
bear_case: $22B cap / ~$83B FDV on ~$770M annualized holder revenue (~29x / ~108x) while volume share erodes 58% -> 38%
~74% of supply non-circulating; monthly contributor tranches plus 33.8M treasury HYPE are latent sellers
Buyback is pro-cyclical: bearish regime cuts perp volume -> fees -> bid as supply arrives
Relative-strength unwind: HYPE -11% from ATH vs BTC -8.75% / ETH -13% on the month; altcoin OI dominance > 1.0
Five Foundation validators hold ~48.7% of stake (Aug 30) - centralization/governance tail
invalidation: DefiLlama confirms no November contributor transfer and treasuries add

Price is already trending down (-42% in two weeks) into a fully telegraphed supply event.

CoinMarketCal listing of the 16.8B MON unlock

Team re-lock or staking of the unlocked tranche (would be bullish; not announced)
bear_case: $328M of new float vs $12.7M/day volume = ~26 days of total turnover [ESTIMATE]
Insider tokens unlock after a ~99% collapse from the $14-15B valuation implied by pre-launch hyperps - cost basis irrelevant, liquidity-seeking selling dominates

Unlock passes with less than 5% drawdown

confirmed_catalysts.description: 175.75M TIA unlock (DropsTab schedule, reported by Cointelegraph)
TIA -12.84% in 24h to $0.460 (CoinMarketCap AI analysis)

bear_case: ~18% of circulating supply released while price falls 12.8% in a day - distribution already under way
~$450M market cap with no sourced blob-fee revenue (one aggregator shows < $100/day, unverified)

Aggregate perp OI only ~$15-40M - spot-driven market where recipient selling hits price directly

thesis: A $20.8B market cap with no fee revenue, built on a +200% seven-week parabola that has now broken (-28% from the ~$1,700 early-October peak) while $0.5B+ of perp OI keeps leverage in the trade; shielded-pool growth is mostly partially-shielded flow, not fully private adoption.

Coinbase: ZEC $1,222, market cap ~$20.76B, 24h volume $1.387B

Privacy regulation shifts in either direction

name: Ethena
thesis: USDe supply (~$4.7B) is -69% from peak and the approved fee switch only activates at $7.5B, so the buyback is off while ~275M ENA unlock monthly; with BTC funding ~0.005%/8h the basis-trade yield has no edge over a 4.93% 10-year in a Fed hiking cycle.

confirmed_catalysts.description: 275,015,625 ENA unlock (~1.83% of total supply)
1.41B ENA investor unlock (~14.3% of circulating) completed
Fee switch approved: 95% of Foundation net revenue to ENA buybacks, gated on 14-day average USDe supply >= $7.5B

bear_case: Carry collapse: BTC funding ~0.005%/8h (~5% annualized) vs 4.93% 10-year - USDe has no yield edge; supply -69% from ~$15B peak
Buyback requires ~+60% USDe growth to switch on - unreachable in a bearish regime
~275M ENA/month (~$52M at $0.19) of unlocks with no programmatic bid
Revenue is roughly linear in funding, so low funding pushes revenue toward zero (October revenue not sourced)
Risk-off redemptions are reflexive
invalidation: 14-day average USDe supply above $6B and rising
BTC funding above 0.01%/8h for two weeks

name: Uniswap
pair: UNIUSDT & UNI/USDC perp (Binance), UNI-USD (Hyperliquid), UNI/USD spot (Coinbase)
thesis: A programmatic buy-and-burn (17% of swap fees, live since Dec 28, 2025) has retired ~11.4% of total supply, revenue hit a record $15.49M in September, yet UNI is -29% in four weeks at ~$6.89 ($4.3B cap); the October revenue halving is the risk, but the burn gives a measurable yield once the regime stops de-grossing. Staged - not active until the regime flips to mean_reverting.

confirmed_catalysts.description: Fee switch activated on Ethereum: 17% of swap fees to UNI buy-and-burn; 100M UNI treasury burn
Uniswap V4 fee switch enabled (DefiLlama chain breakdown)
Record September protocol revenue $15.49M (DefiLlama) / $14.81M (Token Terminal), Robinhood Chain $7.87M

speculative_catalysts: Higher protocol take rate via governance
Fee switch extended to additional chains
bear_case: October 1-29 revenue $7.58M, roughly half September's pace - a ~2% burn yield is not a floor
53% of September revenue came from one partner chain (Robinhood Chain)
UNI fell 29% in four weeks with burns running - the burn does not set price in a de-gross
17% take rate makes Uniswap LPs less competitive vs zero-fee venues [SPECULATION]
DEX volume is beta to the regime - smallest burn arrives when support is most needed
invalidation: Governance reduces or reverses the fee switch
